_note_batch_validate_code: 2026-11-02: Workaround for a terminology tooling problem, not for content errors.

The HL7 Java validator checks the first code of a ValueSet compose.include or CodeSystem supplement with a single CodeSystem/$validate-code call, then sends the remaining codes as one ValueSet/$batch-validate-code request without a valueSet or url parameter.
Ontoserver rejects every batch entry with 'Type-level request to $validate-code must specify either valueSet or url parameter.' and the validator reports each one as an invalid code.

The affected codes are valid: single $validate-code and $expand return them for SNOMED CT 20250701 and 20260701. See txlog.html in the validation-output artifact of run https://github.com/medizininformatik-initiative/kerndatensatz-basis/actions/runs/41425530629.

2026-11-13: the same cause affects the source codes of ConceptMap mii-cm-person-recordedsexorgender-snomed-administrative-gender (CONCEPTMAP_VS_INVALID_CONCEPT_CODE_VER); the codes are in MII VS Person Recorded Sex or Gender SNOMED and are annotated in input/ignoreWarnings.txt for the IG Publisher. See run https://github.com/medizininformatik-initiative/kerndatensatz-basis/actions/runs/43478236491.
Remove the VALUESET_INCLUDE_INVALID_CONCEPT_CODE_VER, CODESYSTEM_CS_SUPP_INVALID_CODE and CONCEPTMAP_VS_INVALID_CONCEPT_CODE_VER entries below once $batch-validate-code works against Ontoserver.
